name: 記事カテゴリの横タブ
prompt:
Create a standalone Japanese horizontal category-tab strip at the exact proportions of the source crop (1179 x 122 px). Use a clean white background and one horizontal row of five labels, evenly spaced with generous room. Use a regular, readable Japanese sans-serif in medium gray for inactive labels. Make 「今日」 the selected tab with slightly heavier dark teal text and a short teal underline centered directly beneath it. Add a thin light-gray divider along the bottom. The native preview is authoritative for the exact tab labels and selected state; the source crop controls the wide horizontal composition and underline placement.
From left to right, use exactly:
特集　地域　今日　視点　暮らし

Do not add icons, arrows, counts, pills, background fills, or any other copy. Keep the tabs vertically centered above the bottom rule.
reviewNotes: v001を目視確認して候補登録。特集・地域・今日・視点・暮らしの5ラベルと、今日のティール選択状態を再現。原資料の1179×122の横長寸法に合わせて内容範囲を整えた。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: exact horizontal tab-strip proportions and underline geometry
authoritative Japanese tab wording, active state, and Lighthouse teal from native preview
